_note: Humidity comb: two interleaved copper combs on a small board under a thin salt film. 2-terminal: a, b. Engine (bw-board humidity_comb): film resistance r50 (10 MOhm at 50 % RH) falling one decade per decadePct (12) % RH; the relative humidity at the comb is its control (0..1 = 0..100 % RH; breath ~0.9), else params.humidity (%), else the world. Reports humidityPct, ohms, amps.
